priorities.title: Separate author setups from tested bot interpretations
priorities.finding: Kinetic Bull Spike, Asia-only Session Killzones and Pivot Channel long-only are deliberate readings (decisions 67/195). Native alternatives need distinct versions; do not overwrite them or count both as independent evidence.

priorities.title: Bind signal names to source conditions
priorities.finding: High Volume Pivot S/R Zones distinguishes resistance breakout (long), support breakdown (short), and retests of flipped levels. Generic support/resistance direction guesses are unsafe. Direction-shortening such as Dn needs a local contract, never a global activation.

priorities.title: Separate level updates, entries, and exits
priorities.finding: Step Range needs state to determine the side of a shared trailing-start marker. Target Trend draws protection and targets as graphics. A correct entry alone cannot reproduce either author lifecycle.

priorities.title: Use availability time rather than drawing location
priorities.finding: Delayed pivots, retrospective patterns, and previous-bar labels cannot create earlier trades. Last-bar redrawing and viewport-dependent tools are research context unless a causal contract is proved.

priorities.title: Keep candle proxies distinct from measured exchange data
priorities.finding: Long/Short Ratio uses candle-derived participation; HTF Delta Flux liquidations are synthetic estimates. Depth, whale, and liquidity visualizations must not masquerade as Delta account ratios, book depth, or exchange liquidations.

priorities.title: Track behavioural updates and runtime availability
priorities.finding: Volume Delta Pivot Matrix changed its delta allocation; the current upstream import is incompatible. Paid Market Core, Market Waves, Nautilus and Strategy Builder have substantive releases, but their public explanations do not expose an executable source contract.

priorities.title: Exclude explicitly unsuitable candidates
priorities.finding: The author advises against the old MA10/20 script. Manual anchor/visible-range tools and external on-chain tools cannot become autonomous Delta entries merely because a chart displays directional labels.
